identity.title: Measure cancellation and deadline drain timing and terminal state

origin.summary: The remaining 2D reconciliation identifies an existing cancellation/deadline drain contract whose elapsed timing and terminal state are not recorded by a focused operational check.

state.current_summary: 2D-038 is resolved as a bounded measurement slice: the existing Preview and Pipeline owners recorded cancellation/deadline drain timing and terminal state, stale results remained discarded, and the first flaky Preview attempt was preserved alongside two passing reruns. Infinite hang, force-stop, hardware, low-memory, and long-duration qualification remain outside this issue.

objective.summary: Record bounded cancellation/deadline drain elapsed time and final state for the existing native Preview and Pipeline execution owners, preserving stale-result disposal and status distinctions without inventing a new timeout policy.
constraints: Reuse OpenVisionNativePreviewExecutionBoundary and VisionPipelineExecutionService; do not add a new executor, service, or global timeout policy.
Keep the existing Preview generation/discard guard, Pipeline TimedOut/Canceled result contract, and public status wording unchanged.
Do not modify, stage, commit, or push C:\Git\2D\Original.
Do not claim infinite hang, camera/SDK, low-memory, or force-stop recovery qualification from controlled local fixtures.

criteria.text: The actual native Preview boundary records cancellation requested while a controlled slow delegate is active, observes the draining state before completion, reaches idle within a bounded wait, and publishes no stale result or canceled output layer.

The existing Pipeline execution contract records finite deadline and cancellation drain elapsed times, preserves TimedOut versus Canceled, and reports WorkerDrained only after the late task result is released.

The Handoff, reconciliation report, and issue record identify the owner/call path, measured artifacts, self-evaluation, and unverified long-duration/hang/hardware boundaries so the same drain work is not repeated.

context.summary: Single-input Preview snapshots on the UI thread, computes on a worker, and discards stale generations after CancelAndDiscard or Dispose.
Pipeline execution distinguishes Completed, TimedOut, and Canceled, awaits the late worker task, disposes its result image, and marks WorkerDrained.

evidence.observation: The existing owner/call path snapshots native Preview input, computes on the worker, increments the discard generation on CancelAndDiscard, disposes late computation/snapshot data in CompleteOnUi, and reaches idle in EndRun. Pipeline WaitForStepCompletionStatusAsync distinguishes TimedOut/Canceled, awaits the late task, disposes its result image, and returns WorkerDrained=true.

The changed embedded OpenVisionLab Debug build completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, and VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug completed with 0 errors; the runner retained 19 pre-existing nullable warnings outside this slice.

Two reruns of the actual Debug embedded WPF smoke passed. After a controlled 420ms delegate entered its slow section, CancelAndDiscard reported RunningImmediatelyAfterCancel=true, DrainCompleted=true, TerminalBoundaryState=Idle, CanceledLateResultPublished=false, and no discarded output layer. Measured native drain elapsed time was 428.8ms and 431.0ms; the selected window intersected DISPLAY2. No OpenVisionLab process remained afterward.

The existing Pipeline Review execution contract passed. Deadline remained TimedOut with WorkerDrained=true and late-result release elapsed 639.9ms; cancellation remained Canceled with WorkerDrained=true and late-result release elapsed 14.0ms. Both statuses were checked as incomplete before the late task result was supplied, and disposal/generation/duplicate-run checks also passed.

The durable report and live Handoff record PL-0098 as the single 2D-038 owner, link the measured D-drive artifacts, preserve the first failed Preview attempt, document the owner/call path and self-evaluation, update the ledger count to 98 total/93 resolved/1 doing/4 blocked, and remove 2D-038 from the next-admission list.

events.summary: 2D-038 is resolved after bounded native Preview and Pipeline drain timing/state evidence passed; long-duration, hang, force-stop, hardware, and low-memory boundaries remain explicitly unverified.
